property_summary: For every input, C.transfer reverts when given an empty _tos array (it never returns true for _tos.length == 0); the mutant removes that require and thus returns true for some inputs with an empty _tos, violating the rule.
change_summary: Delete the require that enforces non-empty _tos so function can be called with empty array and still return true, changing return behavior for that input.
